subject: general
question: Let x be the least number lying between 8000 and 8500, which when divided by 12, 14, 16, 35 and 84, the remainders are 4, 6, 8, 27 and 76, respectively. The tens digit in x is :
solution:
**Given:**

8000 N = (LCM of divisors)K - Difference

**Calculations:**

In this, if you subtract each remainder from its corresponding divisor you will get,

For ex.

⇒ 12 - 4 = 14 - 6 = 16 - 8 = and so on = 8 

The difference will be constant always. 

LCM of (12, 14, 16, 35, 84) = 1680

⇒ N = (LCM of divisors)K - Difference

Here the only possible value of k is 5

⇒ x = (1680) × 5 - 8

⇒ x = 8400 - 8 = 8392

**∴ The tens digit in x is 9.**
